protocol.title: Macrophage memory emerges from coordinated transcription factor and chromatin dynamics
protocol.platform: Automated microfluidic live-cell imaging + off-chip ATAC-seq and RNA-seq
protocol.cell_type: Primary bone-marrow-derived macrophages (BMDMs) from RelA(mVenus/mVenus) C57BL/6J transgenic mice
protocol.objective: Systematic profiling of innate immune memory in primary macrophages through sequential inflammatory ligand stimulation, live-cell NF-kB dynamics imaging, chromatin accessibility (ATAC-seq), and transcriptomic (RNA-seq) profiling; deep-learning prediction of memory-conditioned gene expression

device.control: Pneumatic solenoid valves driven by custom MATLAB graphical interface

mouse_model.fluorescent_tag: mVenus fused to endogenous RelA (NF-kB subunit)

LPS.full_name: Ultrapure LPS from E. coli O111:B4

reagents.ligand_storage: -80 C; reconstituted in ultrapure water; single-use aliquots
reagents.ligand_delivery: Diluted in complete media + 20 ng/mL m-CSF immediately before use; stored on ice; 4 psi via PEEK tubing

atac_seq_reagents.lysis_buffer: 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 3 mM MgCl2, 10 mM NaCl, 0.1% IGEPAL CA-630
atac_seq_reagents.transposase_mix: 25 uL 2X TD Buffer (Illumina) + 2.5 uL TD Enzyme 1 (Illumina) + 22.5 uL nuclease-free water

rna_seq_reagents.sequencing_platform: NextSeq550 (Illumina), NextSeq 500/550 high output kit v2

steps.name: BMDM differentiation — initial seeding
steps.notes: Bone marrow isolated from femurs and tibias of 6-12 week old RelA^V/V mice. Seeded in complete RPMI + 20 ng/mL m-CSF to initiate macrophage differentiation.

steps.name: BMDM differentiation — Day 2 feed
steps.notes: Fresh complete media + m-CSF added on Day 2.

steps.name: BMDM differentiation — Day 4 feed
steps.notes: Fresh complete media + m-CSF added on Day 4.

steps.name: BMDM differentiation — Day 6 feed and Day 7 lift
steps.notes: Day 6 feed with m-CSF. Day 7-9: adherent BMDMs washed with PBS, lifted with EDTA/PBS, resuspended at 10^7 cells/mL in phenol-red-free RPMI for device loading.

steps.name: Microfluidic device coating and priming
steps.notes: Device chambers coated overnight with 0.2-0.4 mg/mL fibronectin in PBS. Flushed with complete media before cell loading. Device mounted on Nikon Ti2 at 37 C / 5% CO2 / 98% humidity.

steps.name: Hoechst staining and cell loading onto microfluidic device
steps.notes: 1 uM Hoechst 33342 in complete media for 5 min; washed with complete media. Cells loaded and allowed to adhere ~30 min before imaging. No phototoxicity or cell death observed over 12-16 h imaging.

steps.name: Ligand A stimulation — polyI:C (PRIMING arm, Arm 1)
steps.notes: polyI:C activates TLR3/TRIF pathway; primes subsequent NF-kB response to TNF-a. Representative condition from 80-condition screen (Fig 1F, 2A, 2C). Positive controls: media -> 10 ng/mL TNFa; media -> 1 ng/mL LPS. Negative control: complete media only.

steps.name: Ligand B stimulation — TNF-a (PRIMING arm, Arm 1)
steps.notes: Ligand A aspirated; Ligand B delivered via same channel. NF-kB nuclear translocation (RelA-mVenus Nuc/Cyto ratio) tracked at 6-min intervals over 240 min. >300 cells per condition; two independent preparations.

steps.name: Ligand A stimulation — CpG (TOLERANCE arm, Arm 2)
steps.notes: CpG activates TLR9/MyD88 pathway; tolerises NF-kB response to subsequent TNF-a. Parallel run on separate chamber set (deviceWithCells_arm2). Highest tolerising dose (Fig 1E, 2A).

steps.name: Ligand B stimulation — TNF-a (TOLERANCE arm, Arm 2)
steps.notes: CpG arm Ligand B step. NF-kB dynamics tracked identically to Arm 1.

steps.name: Live-cell NF-kB dynamics detection and QC gate
steps.readout: RelA-mVenus nuclear/cytoplasmic (Nuc/Cyto) ratio per cell per 6-min frame

metrics.AUC: trapezoidal approximation over 240 min Ligand B window
metrics.max_amplitude: identified via loess-smoothed trace (3-frame interval, min prominence 0.1)
metrics.normalisation: AUC from memory-conditioned cells divided by mean naive AUC (AUC_0) for same Ligand B

mutual_information.method: Jetka et al. 2019, PLOS Comp Biol
mutual_information.input: dynamic vector of 20 evenly-spaced time points over 4 h stimulus interval

steps.image_analysis: MATLAB 2021a; flat field + dark frame correction; nuclear segmentation from Hoechst channel; cell tracking >99% accuracy over 8 h

steps.name: ATAC-seq — BMDM replating and stimulation
steps.notes: BMDMs replated on Day 7 from matureBMDMs dispense; overnight rest in complete media + m-CSF before stimulation.

steps.name: ATAC-seq — nuclei isolation
steps.lysis_buffer: 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5 / 3 mM MgCl2 / 10 mM NaCl / 0.1% IGEPAL CA-630
steps.notes: Cold lysis to preserve nuclei integrity. Centrifuge step modelled as heat(4C, 10m) in BioScript.

steps.name: ATAC-seq — transposase reaction
steps.transposase_mix: 25 uL 2X TD Buffer + 2.5 uL TD Enzyme 1 (Illumina) + 22.5 uL nuclease-free water
steps.notes: Transposase fragments open chromatin and tags with sequencing adapters. Modelled as heat(37C, 30m) in BioScript.

steps.name: ATAC-seq — PCR amplification, library prep, and QC gate

bioinformatics.peak_merging: iterative overlap peak merging (Corces et al. 2018)

steps.name: RNA-seq — BMDM replating and sequential stimulation
steps.notes: Ligand A applied 4 h; aspirated; Ligand B applied 4 h; aspirated; cells lysed. Media aspirated between each step.

steps.name: RNA-seq — cell lysis and RNA extraction
steps.notes: Aspirate Ligand B; add RLT buffer directly to well; RNA extracted from lysate using Dynabeads.

steps.name: RNA-seq — reverse transcription, library prep, and QC gate
steps.sequencing: NextSeq550 (Illumina), NextSeq 500/550 high output kit v2

bioinformatics.differential_expression: edgeR + limma; FDR < 0.01, fold change > 1 vs naive
bioinformatics.synergy_antagonism_formula: DAB_memory = (AB - (B + dAB + dB)) / (B + dAB + dB); synergy > 0.25, antagonism < -0.25

input_features.atac_detail: Peak accessibility (CPM) and TF motif counts for 18 TFs across 3 most proximal ATAC peaks in proximal (-1500 to +500 bp) and distal (-3000 to -1500 / +500 to +3000 bp) promoter regions; chromatin regulators without motifs (EZH2, HDAC, NELFE)
input_features.nfkb_detail: Peak height, AUC, and activation time per stimulation condition

deep_learning_model.output: 4-class gene expression classification per gene per stimulus condition
deep_learning_model.layers: 2-3 hidden layers; first layer = n_inputs nodes; subsequent layers = half or quarter of prior layer

key_results.chromatin_finding: Initial stimulus dominates chromatin landscape even after re-exposure to second stimulus; first stimulus Spearman r ~0.79 vs second stimulus r ~0.37-0.44

in_vivo_model.model: Sublethal murine endotoxemia (12.5 mg/kg LPS i.p.)
in_vivo_model.readout: Peritoneal macrophages isolated 4 h post-injection; NF-kB dynamics in microfluidic device
in_vivo_model.result: TNF-a response significantly attenuated; LPS response completely abolished in endotoxin-treated mice

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.content: BMDM differentiation, device prep, cell loading, sequential ligand stimulation (both arms)

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.content: dispose CpG arm + NF-kB signals; begin ATAC-seq branch

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_7_j
basic_blocks.content: dispose ATAC signal; begin RNA-seq branch

duration_conversions.240m: 4 h (ligand stimulation / NF-kB imaging); IR: 14400.0 SECOND
duration_conversions.10m: 10 min (centrifugation / nuclei lysis cold step); IR: 600.0 SECOND
duration_conversions.5m: 5 min (Hoechst stain / cell lysis); IR: 300.0 SECOND

fixes_applied: FIX3: Split deviceWithCells into deviceWithCells_arm1 and deviceWithCells_arm2 to prevent double-consumption of same IR variable by priming and tolerance arms
bioscript.biological_scope_note: 80-condition ligand screen represented by two arms: polyI:C->TNFa (priming) and CpG->TNFa (tolerance). All 6 ligands x dose x duration combinations follow the same structure and require separate .bs files or parameterised extensions.
